name: HumanNeRF
definition: A neural representation for high-fidelity free-view synthesis of dynamic humans that generalizes to unseen subjects and camera settings using sparse RGB inputs, avoiding per-scene training through aggregated pixel-alignment features and a pose-embedded non-rigid deformation field.
summary: HumanNeRF is a generalizable neural radiance field method that synthesizes high-fidelity dynamic human views from sparse inputs without per-scene training by aggregating pixel-aligned features and using a pose-embedded deformation field.
